_comment: Shared design presets. Everyone who loads the site sees these. Save one in /admin (Presets tab), hit 'Copy presets.json', paste the result here, commit and push. If PM_CONFIG.presetsApi is set, the studio reads and writes live presets from that Worker instead and this file becomes the fallback.

presets.name: Locked — green accent
presets.note: The current build. Cream ground, navy copy, forest accent.

presets.name: Warmer — clay accent
presets.note: Same grounds, burnt red carrying the accent instead of green.

presets.name: Flame — Miki's second palette
presets.note: Warm cream ground, near-black oxblood for type and dark bands, flame as the accent, mustard as the spark. Contrast checked: nothing that carries words is under 4.5.
